**GASTONIA, N.C. –** United Bank recently welcomed Edward Timberlake, Jr., as Gastonia Market president. In this role, Timberlake will lead efforts to grow United’s commercial and retail banking business in Gaston County, while strengthening the Bank’s presence in the community. Additionally, he will represent United through civic engagement, professional organizations, and other community initiatives.


Timberlake is based in United’s Gastonia office, which serves the Bank’s customers throughout Gaston County, including Gastonia, Belmont, Lowell, Bessemer City, Kings Mountain, and surrounding areas.


“As Gastonia continues to attract new growth and investment, United Bank remains committed to being an active partner in the market’s future,” said United Bank Regional President Jerry Ocheltree. “Edward brings extensive experience in commercial banking, small business lending, and community development, along with a strong passion for relationship-based banking that aligns with how we serve our customers and communities. His leadership and regional knowledge will be invaluable as we expand our presence throughout the region.”


Timberlake joins United Bank with more than 20 years of banking and community development experience, including nearly eight years in community business lending at Fifth Third Bank.


Throughout his career, Timberlake has been recognized for his commitment to expanding financial access and supporting underserved communities. He holds a Small Business Lending Certificate from Credit Risk Management and an Economic Development Finance Professional (EDFP) certification from Grow America (formerly the National Development Council).


“United's ability to combine the capabilities of a larger institution with the relationship-focused approach of a community bank is what drew me to this opportunity,” said Timberlake. “I am looking forward to building on the Bank’s presence in the market and deepening our impact across the community.”


A High Point native, Timberlake graduated from North Carolina A&T State University with a bachelor’s degree in political science and a minor in finance. He currently serves as chair of the board of C.W. Williams Community Health Center and on the board of Aspire Community Capital. Timberlake is also an active member of Omega Psi Phi Fraternity, Inc. He and his daughter, Gia Elise, currently live in the Charlotte area and plan to relocate to Belmont.


**ABOUT UNITED BANK**


United Bank is a premier community bank and a subsidiary of United Bankshares, Inc. (NASDAQ: UBSI). United has consolidated assets of approximately $34 billion with over 240 offices located across North Carolina, South Carolina, Georgia, Virginia, West Virginia, Maryland, Ohio, and Pennsylvania, as well as Washington D.C. The Bank is dedicated to growing the relationships it has built since 1839 and offering a competitive suite of banking and lending products, treasury management, wealth management, mortgage services, personal and business credit cards, and more.[Learn more](https://www.bankwithunited.com/about-united.html) about United Bank.
